summary: Push the Claude channel attachment over the driver's title stream instead of polling it every second

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes. Diagnostic publication keeps its idempotency keys, episodes and exactly-once resolution of a sent operation.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. Push state is in daemon memory only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The mailbox stream gains an Attachment frame, sent only on a title stream whose driver reports attachment_push, so older drivers never receive it. A new driver on an older daemon receives no frame and keeps the per-second GET, which is unchanged and still served. The agent view gains delivery.attachment_push for Claude seats; clients ignore the unknown field.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. A driver re-executing into the new binary uses the GET until its connection pushes the first frame.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No database or graph state changes. The driver's graceful re-exec resume file (a JSON file written to disk by st_drivers::reexec::write_state) gains an admission bucket and a per-operation attempted flag. An older binary ignores both: DriverResume, NativeLoopState and PendingClaudeAttachment derive Deserialize without deny_unknown_fields, and st_drivers::reexec::decode_state reads them with serde_json. Swapping back to an older daemon or driver returns to the per-second GET.
